questions.question: What is the difference between volume and pitch?
questions.expected_answer: Volume is how loud or soft a sound is. Pitch is how high or low a sound is. They are different, so a sound can be loud and low, or soft and high.

questions.question: How can you make a drum sound louder, and why does it work?
questions.expected_answer: Hit it harder. More input energy makes the drum skin vibrate more, with bigger vibrations, and bigger vibrations make a louder sound.

questions.question: Give two ways to make a guitar string play a higher note.
questions.expected_answer: Tighten the string by turning its peg, or press the string down on the neck to make the vibrating part shorter. A thinner string also plays a higher note.
